question: Margie’s car can go \(32\) miles on a gallon of gas, and gas currently costs \(\$4\) per gallon. How many miles can Margie drive on \(\$20\) worth of gas?
solution:
First find how much gas \(\$20\) buys. At \(\$4\) per gallon, Margie can buy \(20\div4=5\) gallons. Each gallon allows her to drive \(32\) miles, so she can drive
\[
5\times32=160\text{ miles}.
\]
The answer is \(160\) miles, choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
